note: Archer, front view. The right hand grips the curved bow: its upper limb (tip at x~765,y~388 down to the grip) and the lower tip piece at x705-778, y685-722 are equipment, kept off the hand; the long diagonal bar across the body (with the upper-left tip, arrows and quiver) looks like a separate slung item and stays torso, although the lower tip piece may really be that bar's end (uncertain). Tunic hem y~747 is the hip. Left arm (image left) is hanging at the side behind the pouch: only the green sleeve patch is visible, so the left upper arm is labelled (y462-575) and the forearm and hand are hidden. Right arm: upper sleeve y462-548, elbow y548 where the sleeve turns darker green, forearm sleeve to wrist y566, then the small pale hand (y566-616) beside the bow grip; the arm is tiny and partly guesswork. Bare thighs show under the hem (y747-792); boots start at y~795 with short shafts, so knee is halfway hip to ankle y~792, above the boot top; ankle at the instep y837.
